verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a dedicated Systematic Reviews workflow that runs from setup and gathering through title/abstract screening and a distinct automated full-text screening step to column-based data extraction across papers. The API exposes explicit control over screening criteria and extraction parameters, and results export as screening recommendation and extraction tables. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of screening/extraction accuracy at scale, and detailed UI documentation of how the same screening criteria are defined and applied to every paper.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: The Systematic Reviews workflow provides step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers.
Systematic Review: run a full review end to end, with control over search strategy, screening criteria, extraction parameters, and reporting.
Full-Text Screening is a distinct, automated step in the Systematic Review workflow that catches these mismatches before you commit to data extraction.
Create a column for each data point you'd like to extract from your papers.
Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.
